svg.title: 2. Two decisions, two policy interfaces
svg.desc: Scheduler uses the abstract SortStrategy, implemented by FifoSort and PrioritySort. Placer uses the abstract PlaceAlgorithm, implemented by PackAlgorithm and SpreadAlgorithm. Topology builds a TopologyView; the placement algorithm reads its distance information.
svg.metadata: Lettering: Virgil by Ellinor Rapp. SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/excalidraw/virgil

g.aria-label: Queue ordering can change independently of the physical resource choice.
Solid arrow: uses / creates. Hollow arrow: implements. Dashed arrow: reads the view.
